description: Architected enterprise GraphRAG pipelines and scalable LLM microservices for Investment Banking analysts while adhering to strict financial data governance, compliance, and audit frameworks.
highlights: Led the architecture and implementation of a GraphRAG pipeline on proprietary financial documents, integrating the system into the existing enterprise codebase.

Built asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI on Azure Functions to serve LLM-backed tools for IB analysts, utilizing Azure AI Foundry, AI Search, Cosmos DB, and Blob Storage for reliable deployment at scale.
Implemented binary quantization techniques for vector embeddings within Azure AI Search, reducing vector index space utilization by up to 32x while preserving retrieval speed and accuracy.

Optimized document parsing by designing a hybrid classification system (rule-based and probabilistic) with 1-second average inference, bypassing unnecessary OCR via Azure Document Intelligence to achieve a 15–20x speedup.
Designed prompt engineering strategies and GenAI orchestration workflows for banker-facing tools, ensuring accurate, compliant, and audit-ready LLM outputs.

role: Teaching Assistant — Software Tools & Techniques for AI
description: Selected as Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for CS203: Software Tools and Techniques for AI, guiding junior undergraduate students through practical engineering paradigms.
highlights: Guided 160+ undergraduate students in applying AI frameworks, version control, and development tools through lab sessions.
Collaborated with course faculty to design assignments, create rubrics, evaluate coursework, and mentor students.

description: Conducted core research on zero-shot and parameter-efficient fine-tuning evaluation of Vision-Language Models on thermal imagery; work culminated in ThermEval, accepted for poster presentation at KDD 2026 (Datasets & Benchmarks Track).
highlights: Formulated evaluation protocols across 70,000+ VQA thermal samples across 25 leading foundation models (0.3B–235B parameters).
Engineered an automated LLM-based output parser validated on 1,200 human-annotated gold samples with >98% agreement.
Investigated fine-tuning dynamics using LoRA on an 8B model, closing the gap towards human-level reasoning in thermal scenes.
Published research paper in the main track at KDD 2026 (A* Machine Learning Conference).

description: Contributed to an AI software platform that optimizes commodity trading by analyzing global markets, sentiment dynamics, trade regulations, and geopolitical events while avoiding embargo restrictions.
highlights: Designed a Reddit sentiment analysis module by identifying and scraping 200+ economic and political subreddits via API.
Analyzed sentiment using both comments and post interaction scores, leveraging LLMs and Named Entity Recognition (NER) to compute risk scores for country-specific events.
Built interactive dashboard interfaces and demonstrated the live system to stakeholders.
